observation.command: echo "=== Tomcat direct ports ==="; for p in 18080 18081 18082; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} " -m 20 "http://localhost:$p/xplan-manager-web/"; done; echo; echo "=== Apache proxy config (xplan) ==="; grep -rE "ProxyPass|proxy_pass|18080|18081|18082" /etc/apache2/ 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "xplan|1808|mapserver" | head -30
